title: Table of every concentric row (and of the controls)
caption: Every micropolar row between concentric cylinders (R1 = 4 g, R2 = 5 g, U = Omega R1, w = 0 on both walls, Ma = 0.02, end time 2 g^2 / nu_inf, last quarter averaged). D_SPH: the potential-vortex constant of the velocity fit over that of the run's Newtonian control, minus one; D_exact and D_rule (the rule in its slip form) with the hydrodynamic radii of the control; noise floor: spread of the control's beta over three lattices, over D_exact; steady: relative change of the fitted constant between the last two eighths of the run; drifts: change of the fluid's mean density (over rho0) and mean pressure (over rho U^2) between the last two eighths ('-' where the run did not record them). The second table lists the controls. 18 rows; D_SPH / D_exact by l / dx: l = 5 dx: 1.0214 to 1.0303; l = 10 dx: 1.0038 to 1.0065; l = 20 dx: 1.0004 to 1.0004; l = 25 dx: 0.9991 to 1.0009; l = 50 dx: 0.9970 to 1.0000. Largest departure: `g100_k3_m10`, 1.0303. Tag `thesis-ch5-rc1`, `thesis-ch5-rc1-1-ga07f93d`, `thesis-ch5-rc1-3-g645dc15`, `thesis-ch5-rc1-2-gad23a67`.
